title: Investors, tell me what you want
author: CheesecakeOpening637
selftext:
I'm working on [gm.markets](http://gm.markets) that lets users buy tokenized US stocks which settle on chain and are backed by shares at regulated US brokers.

What I'm spending most of my time on now is the research layer, each stock page currently has live news from CNBC, Reuters, Benzinga, key stats, market cap, volume, 52 week range, day high low and a filterable news section by ticker.

Now its good but its not enough because every platform does some version of this and none of them do it well enough that you stop opening other tabs and I want to be the one that does.

I want to hear from people who actually buy US stocks from outside US, what does your research look like before you make a trade and what do you wish was just there in front of you?

Thanks!
